lore_anchors.definition: A legendary, near-priceless liquid that restores a cultivator's entire magic power with a single sip. It is the ultimate emergency resource, formed over tens of thousands of years in special spiritual springs.

One of the fabled "Three Divine Trees" in cultivation lore. This wood can safely house a cultivator's soul, preserving their consciousness if their physical body is destroyed, making it a powerful soul-preservation artifact.
A legendary class of mythical trees in xianxia lore, each possessing unique and powerful properties for cultivation and soul-preservation. Soul-Nourishing Wood is one of them.
A defensive or trapping mechanism, often magical in nature, that can block passage, teleport intruders, or trigger other effects.
A pre-arranged magical array that allows for instantaneous travel over great distances.
A place where concentrated spiritual energy has condensed into a liquid state. Soaking in or consuming water from such a spring can rapidly replenish a cultivator's magic power and vitality.
